evidence.quote:
requires a signed release
manifest before it ships

observations.why: Mandating a signed manifest before deployment appeals to security and process control as the governing good.

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Justifying the gate by prior security failures appeals to stability and prevention as the motivating value.
Declaring a required manifest as a gate appeals to security and verifiable craft as the governing good.
Extending the gate's scope to both staging and production appeals to comprehensive security coverage as the good.
Naming an owner appeals to accountability and mastery — someone is responsible for the gate's quality.

mints.name: GateAsSecurityMandate
mints.title: a gate is the whole reason for the gate
mints.frame: Is the expression appealing to a security or process gate as the governing good that justifies the action?
